US To Sell $58 Bln In 3-Year Notes Tue
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $58 billion in 3-year notes Tuesday.
The debt will settle on Sept. 15, 2026 and will mature Sept. 15, 2029.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 3-year notes, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 12:00 PM Eastern Time Tuesday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 1:00 PM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
